name: Nowa
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the start of the game as the main protagonist.

name: Seign
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the battle at Hishahn Front when he breaks away from the Imperial army to ally with Nowa.

name: Melridge
howToRecruit: Joins automatically after the battle for Hishahn Front as the Alliance's lead tactician and military adviser.

name: Garr
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the start of the game alongside Lian and Mio as a veteran mercenary squad leader.

name: Lian
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the start of the game as part of Nowa's initial expedition squad in Arenside.

name: Mio
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the start of the game as part of Nowa's initial expedition squad in Arenside.

name: Perrielle
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the main story campaign in Eucrisse (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Hildi
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Seign Kesling following the battle at Hishahn Front.

name: Rody
howToRecruit: Speak to him in the center of Dabavin, select 'Can I talk you into joining us?', and bring him a Pearl Pocketwatch (found in Seaside Cavern or dropped by enemies in Eastern Desert).

name: Maxim
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall during the Athrabalt War storyline to aid the Alliance.

name: Mellore
howToRecruit: Speak with her on the central street of Eltisweiss during 'The Watch Captain's First Job', track her to Redthroat Ridge, and defeat the Nerthus boss to recruit her.

name: Yuferius
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the sandcraft race competition during 'Shi'arcs of a Scale'.

name: Iris
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the 'Hoist the Alliance Banner' story scene to manage castle drafting and blueprints.

name: Gocteau
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the 'Hoist the Alliance Banner' story scene to manage guild dispatch missions.

name: Marisa
howToRecruit: Playable earlier in the campaign, but officially joins the Alliance roster during the journey to Norristar.

name: Dr. Corque
howToRecruit: Speak to Reid in southwest Eltisweiss, then visit Dr. Corque's lab in the southeast. Defeat the three spinadiers (Taq in Altverden, Fender in Kyshiri, Celera in Werne) in Beigoma battles and return to Dr. Corque to recruit him.

name: Huang
howToRecruit: Speak to him in Arenside and answer 'Love it' to receive the Bamboo Rod. Later in Hishahn, speak to him near the docks and deliver a Wheel-Eye Bream caught at the seaside fishing spot in southwest Eucrisse.

name: Wayve
howToRecruit: Joins automatically as the Guardians' liaison during the 'A Secret Plan' story conference.

name: Markus
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during 'The Next Steps' story quest when assisting him in investigating his ancestral castle.

name: Hakugin
howToRecruit: Speak to her on the east side of Daphan Village with Mio in your active battle party, and accept her request to join.

name: Ivy
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the conclusion of Seign's infiltration of the imperial Rune-Lens Research Laboratory (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Yusuke
howToRecruit: Speak to him in pink armor near the entrance gate of Fort Xialuke during or after 'The Watch Captain's First Job' and invite him to join.

name: Yume
howToRecruit: After recruiting Mellore, speak to Yume's grandmother in Werne, then travel to Redthroat Ridge to find Yume and Friend at the large crater to recruit them.

name: Maureus
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the Mountain Path with a character in your party whose MP is 300 or higher (e.g. Francesca, Mellore, or Falward with accessories).

name: Yaelu
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Ivy at the end of Seign's mission in the Rune-Lens Research Laboratory (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Reyna
howToRecruit: Speak to her at Dabavin harbor and accept her challenge. Reduce her HP by half within 2-3 turns (using charged physical attacks or dark runes), then speak to her again and select 'Let's join forces'.

name: Barnard
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the battle for Hishahn Front alongside Melridge and Seign.

name: Gigina
howToRecruit: Talk to this beastfolk fighter across the wooden bridge near the tents in southeast Arenside (requires Nowa at level 9+) and invite him to join.

name: Wyler
howToRecruit: Speak to him near the entrance of Bounty Hill and agree to help search for his sister Marin, then locate her deeper in the hills.

name: Marin
howToRecruit: Recruited alongside her brother Wyler in Bounty Hill after finding her west of the silver chest (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Pieter
howToRecruit: Speak to him tending vegetables in the northwest farm of Werne and answer his questions positively about food and farming to recruit him.

name: Squash
howToRecruit: Speak to him near the Trading Post in Treefolk Village; bring him a Sparklestone (dropped by Phantombirds or Red Wyverns in Dappled Forest).

name: Ormond
howToRecruit: Speak to him in the Abandoned Mine accessible from the castle basement well, and deliver 3 Iron Ore to him.

name: Kerrin
howToRecruit: Speak to her inside the Dappled Forest east of the entrance and deliver 20 Lumber to her.

name: Douglas
howToRecruit: Talk to him inside the Eltisweiss smithy during or after 'New Forces' and deliver 10 Iron Ore to him.

name: Syd
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 3, speak to him outside the Smithy in Hishahn with 1 Iron Ore, 1 Mystic Lumber, and 1 Dire Beastbone in your stowpack inventory.

name: Kurtz
howToRecruit: Speak to him outside the Hishahn smithy; deliver the Grilled Tutuva recipe (obtained from an NPC near the stairs south of Trading Post in Treefolk Village).

name: Code L
howToRecruit: Talk to him in the Daphan Village rune shop and bring him a Rune of Currents (guaranteed drop from the Pagurian boss in Hishahn Old Town).

name: Hogan
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the pier in Twinhorne West, then generate 50,000 Baqua in cumulative trade profits across regional trading posts and speak to him again.

name: Cassandra
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the retreat from Eltisweiss to establish the headquarters Inn.

name: Carrie
howToRecruit: Encounter her clumsy teleportation attempts three times across the bridges of Hishahn (northwest, northeast, and southeast) until she formally joins.

name: Stadler
howToRecruit: Speak to him in yellow attire on the beach in Impershi'arc and defeat his military squadron in a mock war battle.

name: Nell
howToRecruit: Inspect the suspiciously moving large sack hidden behind market stalls near the northwest bridge in Hishahn to recruit him.

name: Paquia
howToRecruit: Speak to her near the lower bridge in Arenside and bring her 5 Regular Eggs (dropped by Eggfoot enemies).

name: Frida
howToRecruit: Visit Werne once fast travel is unlocked, speak to her at the armor stall to the left of the entrance, and let her inspect Nowa's styling to recruit her.

name: Quinn
howToRecruit: Requires Nowa at Level 37+. Speak to her outside the Inn in Impershi'arc, then at the harbor. Explore the Den of the Dunes in the Great Sandy Sea and defeat the boss at all sinkholes to recruit her.

name: Goldsmid
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the second floor of Yarnaan with a party member whose PWR (Power) stat is 180 or higher (e.g. Yusuke or Yuferius) and select 'I'm looking for stalwart allies'.

name: Kuroto
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the southwest side of Altverden during or after 'The Watch Captain's First Job', then defeat 3 Wild Boars in Redthroat Ridge and report back.

name: Clarke
howToRecruit: Speak to him near the fountain in Ardinale, acquire 'The Star-Cross'd Lovers' script (a rare find at the Ardinale City Tool Shop), and deliver it to him.

name: Mariette
howToRecruit: Speak to her on the bench in Twinhorne East, then retrieve Mariette's Charm from a chest gimmick during battle against a Rabbit Archwitch in The Greatwood-South.

name: Ymir
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the retreat from Eltisweiss to serve as chief castle administrator.

name: Selbineth
howToRecruit: Requires HQ Level 3 and 80+ recruited allies. Build the Mysterious Room in the castle basement via Drafting Studio, enter the red portal, and complete her combat trial.

name: Leon
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 2 or above; find him collapsed outside the western entrance of Headquarters and speak to him to recruit him.

name: Aoi
howToRecruit: After completing the Athrabalt Summit, speak to her near the ramp in lower Twinhorne East with Iugo in your party, and defeat her in a one-on-one duel with Iugo.

name: Riufan
howToRecruit: Requires Nowa at Level 32+. Speak to him by the water wheel on the dock in northern Hishahn and defeat him in a one-on-one duel with Nowa.

name: B'baba
howToRecruit: Visit the northwest house in Daphan Village during or after 'New Forces' and invite the fortune teller to HQ.

name: Faye
howToRecruit: Requires recruiting B'baba, Yusuke, Francesca, and Yume. Speak to B'baba in her divination parlor at HQ, then speak to Yusuke on the rooftop, Francesca on 1F, and Yume on 2F outside Great Hall to recruit Faye.

name: Lam
howToRecruit: Recruit Riufan first, speak to Riufan at HQ inn, then travel to Daphan Village with Riufan in your party and speak to Lam near the Rune Shop to recruit her.

name: Valentin
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Seign Kesling following the battle at Hishahn Front.

name: Foxiel
howToRecruit: Speak to her near the fountain and yellow stall in eastern Athrabalt. Consult chef Kurtz at HQ to prepare Vegetable Milk Soup and deliver it to her.

name: Iugo
howToRecruit: Enter the tavern in eastern Eltisweiss during 'The Watch Captain's First Job' and speak with him to recruit him.

name: Aire
howToRecruit: Speak to her near the southwest exit in Hishahn and defeat her in a footrace (requires Nowa to have 135+ SPD, typically reached at Level 36 or via speed accessories).

name: Rohan
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 3, reach a castle population of 5,000+, complete the Athrabalt Front, and speak to him inside the Twinhorne West Inn.

name: Glen
howToRecruit: Return to Arenside once fast travel is unlocked, talk to him outside the western residence, and defeat a challenger in a Card Battle.

name: Lakian
howToRecruit: Joins automatically before the final battle after his brother Alwe convinces him to defect to the Alliance during the storming of Castle Harganthia.

name: Lilwn
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the story mission 'The Revenant Army Returns' in Yarnaan.

name: Jorhan
howToRecruit: Speak to him outside Hishahn Trading Post with Perrielle in your party. Appraise Unknown Antiques gathered from Scarabs in Eastern Desert to find a Yellow Rose Censer and deliver it.

name: Falward
howToRecruit: Speak to him inside the clinic in northwest Altverden during or after 'Reveal Harlan's Schemes' and deliver 15 Healing Herbs to him.

name: Nil
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the journey to Norristar after visiting the forest Rune Barrow with Nowa, Marisa, and Garoo.

name: Chandra
howToRecruit: Build the Training Grounds at HQ (requires Code L), trigger the rumor about a dragon, put Code L in party as Support, head to Eldroad northern ruins fork, and defeat Chandra.

name: Aleior
howToRecruit: MISSABLE: During 'To Norristar, the Western Nation', place Marisa in your active battle party, travel to the Abandoned Mine boss chamber, and defeat Aleior before departing for Castle Harganthia.

name: Dijkstra
howToRecruit: After completing the Athrabalt Front, speak to him on the west pier in Twinhorne East. Traverse the Chelonian Goliath (Vilashnu) dungeon and defeat the Goblomancer boss to recruit him.

name: Alwe
howToRecruit: Joins automatically as the elven representative during the Alliance journey to Norristar.

name: Pohl
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Seign Kesling following the battle at Hishahn Front.

name: Francesca
howToRecruit: Walk up the left stairs in Altverden Village during 'The Watch Captain's First Job' to trigger a cutscene defending her, then recruit her.

name: Momo
howToRecruit: Speak to Momo by the bridge south of the Hishahn Smithy, enter Seaside Cavern, and defeat the Kraken boss to recruit Momo.

name: El Alicanto
howToRecruit: After the war council decision in Athrabalt War Arc, travel north to the dead end in Snowpeak Pass where the bomb was planted and defeat El Alicanto in a one-on-one duel with Nowa.

name: Gieran
howToRecruit: Find him at a campfire on the spiral river island in Greatwood East; deliver a Rune of Conservation (dropped by the Ancient Seed sub-boss in The Proving Grounds).

name: Mihlu
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at Castle HQ after completing both 'Shi'arcs of a Scale' and 'The Rune-Lens Research Laboratory'.

name: Milana
howToRecruit: Upgrade the Castle Rune Shop to Level 2 via Drafting Studio to unlock Runeshards, then enter the shop to trigger her recruitment scene.

name: Sabine
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the early story conference with Lady Perrielle after the burning of Kyshiri Village.

name: Kallathor
howToRecruit: Joins automatically after helping the Treefolk cleanse the Dendriarch in the Greatwood and clearing the Proving Grounds.

name: Rudy
howToRecruit: When Rudy interrupts the summit in Athrabalt seeking help for trapped village children, accompany him through the Ice Cave and defeat the Fenrir boss.

name: CJ
howToRecruit: Place Garoo and Isha in your active party, speak to CJ at the HQ central entrance during the Guardians Arc, and defeat the Prometheus boss in Northern Runebarrows (Grum County).

name: Isha
howToRecruit: Speak to her near the fountain in southeast Eltisweiss: locate a lost black cat in southwest town, obtain a Cockatrice Egg from Mountain Path, and deliver a package to Arenside general store.

name: Garoo
howToRecruit: Playable earlier in the campaign, but officially joins the Alliance roster alongside Marisa during the journey to Norristar.

name: Chron
howToRecruit: Speak to him standing on the road near the south gate of Castle Town after returning from the Proving Grounds to build the castle gate.

name: Sumire
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the retreat from Eltisweiss to operate castle item storage.

name: Caine
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during 'Hoist the Alliance Banner' to establish fast-travel appraisal and town development.

name: Hiro
howToRecruit: Encounter him in the eastern cavern of the Abandoned Mine mid-point; assist him in clearing cave-in rubble to establish his medicine shop.

name: Allaby
howToRecruit: After completing the regional story events in Athrabalt / Norristar, speak to her near the piano in the Headquarters Inn (Hero's Den) to recruit her.

name: Galladur
howToRecruit: After completing Snowpeak Pass, return to The Proving Grounds near the rotating device room. Speak to Galladur sitting outside and defeat a group of enemies in a single turn to recruit him.

name: Cabana
howToRecruit: Requires HQ Level 2+. Speak to Cabana and Pyba beside the Inn in Impershi'arc, and invite him to establish a hot spring bath at Castle HQ.

name: Martha
howToRecruit: Speak to her on the eastern grounds of Castle Town during 'Hoist the Alliance Banner' to unlock pasture farming.

name: Scarlet
howToRecruit: Speak to her at the sandcraft dock in Impershi'arc and beat her record time in a head-to-head sandcraft race (finish in under 01:12:00).

name: Mandie
howToRecruit: Joins automatically immediately after recruiting Paquia in Arenside to serve as race commentator for the eggfoot track.

name: Celia
howToRecruit: Build the kitchen at HQ with Kurtz, then win 15 cooking duel battles against rival chefs hosted by Kurtz at the HQ restaurant; Celia joins upon winning the 15th battle.

name: Reid
howToRecruit: Progress through Dr. Corque's Beigoma questline, collect high-tier tops, defeat all regional spinning top masters, and beat Reid in battle.

name: Shixeen
howToRecruit: Build the Card Shop with Glen, upgrade it to Level 3, collect at least 120 unique cards, and defeat Shixeen in a card match.

name: Euma
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the summit of allied rulers at Athrabalt.

name: Kassius
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Euma during the summit of allied rulers at Athrabalt.

name: Janquis
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Lady Perrielle during the main story campaign in Eucrisse.

name: Elektra
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall after repelling the Imperial invasion before the Final Battle.

name: Vorrdice
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall during the Athrabalt War storyline to aid the Alliance.

name: Viesskin
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall during the Athrabalt War storyline to aid the Alliance.

name: Kogen
howToRecruit: Joins automatically with his bandit crew following the battle and retreat from Eltisweiss.

name: Yuthus
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Kogen following the battle and retreat from Eltisweiss.

name: Zabi
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Kogen and Yuthus following the retreat from Eltisweiss.

name: Yulin
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the climax of the Athrabalt Front when she arrives with the Shi'arc fleet.

name: Skyd
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the sandcraft race competition during 'Shi'arcs of a Scale'.

name: Pastole
howToRecruit: Speak to him beside the Tool Shop in Twinhorne East during the Eucrisse Arc to recruit him directly.

name: Galdorf
howToRecruit: Speak to him at the Abandoned Mine entrance during or after 'Reveal Harlan's Schemes'; bring him Palenight Mail armor (found in the mine near Ormond or crafted at HQ).

name: Prunella
howToRecruit: Speak to her inside the Dabavin Inn during or after 'New Forces' and pay her fee of 100,000 Baqua (she refunds 50,000 immediately).

name: Fume
howToRecruit: Recruit Enoe and establish the Mission Guild first, then speak to Fume in the northeast section of Dappled Forest.

name: Enoe
howToRecruit: Build the Mission Guild via Drafting Studio, then speak to Enoe in Daphan Village to recruit him.

name: Dalton
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 3, build the Mission Guild, place Sabine in your party, and speak to Dalton outside the Twinhorne East Inn.

name: Durlan
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 3; enter the Abandoned Mine from the castle basement well and navigate to the deepest western rock wall to find him chiseling.

name: Larla
howToRecruit: Recruit Enoe and Fume, dispatch guild mission squads until achieving an 'Epic Success', then speak to Larla at the counter in Eltisweiss Inn.

name: Leene
howToRecruit: MISSABLE: You must recruit all other 119 base-game characters before initiating the war council meeting at the castle for the assault on Castle Harganthia. Leene then appears in Castle HQ before the final battle.

name: Grace
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the story chapters of the Seign DLC expansion (requires recapturing Eltisweiss in the main storyline).

name: Goldwyn
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall after repelling the Imperial invasion before the Final Battle.
